basics.name: Yuyang Wu
basics.label: Ph.D. Student
basics.summary: Ph.D. student in AI for Science at Carnegie Mellon University, advised by Olexandr Isayev. Research on self-evolving LLM agents, efficient reasoning, and trustworthy LLMs for chemistry and scientific discovery.

work.name: Carnegie Mellon University
work.summary: Research on LLM reasoning, agents, and trustworthy AI for chemistry in the Isayev Lab.
highlights: Led MolErr2Fix, a benchmark for LLM trustworthiness in chemistry (EMNLP 2025 Oral)
Led ChemCost, a benchmark for evaluating LLM agents on chemical cost reasoning (NeurIPS 2026)
Led CLORE, content-level trajectory optimization for efficient RL reasoning
Co-led KARA, sliding-window KV cache compression for efficient reasoning LLM serving
Created a multi-million-entry quantum chemistry dataset
Collaborated with the CLAW group (CMU LTI), Pitt, and HKUST

education.institution: Carnegie Mellon University, School of Computer Science
National University of Singapore, School of Computing
